brief:
Families across Gaza are struggling to feed their children nutritious meals as commercial food supplies face disruption and prices continue rising, Al Jazeera English reported. The combination of market shortages and reduced aid has left parents unable to afford basic foodstuffs for their households.

The crisis reflects broader difficulties in accessing adequate nutrition in the enclave, with families reporting they lack resources to purchase sufficient food at current market rates.
dek: Families say they are struggling to provide nutritious meals for their children as commercial supplies are disrupted.
title: Gaza children face deepening food crisis as prices surge and aid drops
